references.text: The Levites were to receive cities of refuge, including cities for those who had killed someone accidentally.
Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali is mentioned as one of the cities of refuge.
Describes the inheritance of the tribe of Naphtali, which includes the cities mentioned in this verse.
Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali was designated as a city of refuge for manslayers.
A parallel passage describing the Levitical cities given from the tribe of Naphtali.
Kedesh is mentioned as one of the cities conquered by the Assyrian king Tiglath-Pileser.
